From: Jada
To: Collections, Registrar, Facilities, Development (10)
Subject: FW: Postmortem - loan crate damage / Nwachukwu contract

Apologies all, I know this is the third thing I've put on your calendars this week. Forwarding Uriel's note below so everyone has the context before Thursday.

> From: Uriel Haddad
> Jada, summary for the group: the crate for piece #4 arrived with a cracked corner brace. Object is fine, condition report attached. Shipper has acknowledged fault and is covering the reframe. Rosa already updated the insurance file.

POSTMORTEM AGENDA - Thurs 2:00-2:45, Conference Rm B

1. Timeline of what happend (Uriel, ~10 min)
 - recieved Monday, unpacked Tuesday, damage noted by Kenji
2. Insurance + shipper status (Rosa)
 - claim filed, accepted, nothing pending from us
3. Changes going forward (Yoko)
 - we're adding a photo check at the loading dock, already approved by Gemma
 - updated packing checklist will be shared on the drive
4. Impact on the Nwachukwu contract (Pilar)
 - lender has been notified and is satisfied, no change to the install date
5. Questions

Again, really sorry to pull ten of you into a room for this. Most of it is just walking through what's already been sorted, but I wanted everyone to hear it at the same time so nobody feels out of the loop. If you can't make it, I'll circulate the notes after.

Thanks for your patience, and sorry for the short notice.

Jada
Exhibitions Office, Brightford Museum of Art"},{"spec_id":"spec_0637","text":"Nimbus migration vendor demo - 60 min - all 12 invited - Rm 3"},{"spec_id":"spec_0638","text":"Title: Thistle 2.0 - lookback on the freezer thing
When: Wednesday, 10:00-10:45 AM
Where: Bay 2 break room (coffee's on me)
Attendees: Ilse Brennan, Hector Mbatha, Ulla Yilmaz, Rafael Ekwueme, Vikram Delacroix, Erik Abernathy

Description:
Howdy folks,

Well, we all know the -80 in Bay 2 decided to take itself a little vacation over the weekend, and a good chunk of the Thistle 2.0 aliquots went along for the ride. Nobody's in trouble here. Freezers are like old trucks, they quit when they feel like it.

Figured we'd sit down together for a spell and talk it through. Ilse pulled the temp logs, and Hector has the alarm call records from facilities, so bring whatever you've got on your end too. Rafael, if you could jot down which sample lots we lost and which made it to the backup unit, that'd save us some head-scratching.

I've booked us for 45 minutes, though honestly we might wrap early if folks come with their notes. Or we might wander a bit, you know how we get. Ulla and Vikram, I know you were out when it happened, so no pressure to have anything prepped. Just come listen in.

Erik, holler if the timing doesn't work with your assay run. We can shuffle.

Thanks, all. Appreciate every one of you hauling boxes Monday morning.

Omar"},{"spec_id":"spec_0639","text":"Subject: Mandatory All-Staff Gathering - Friday 9:00-9:30 AM, Main Atrium

To: All Staff (157)

Hello everyone,

Since the last few announcements apparently got lost in some inboxes, we are going to do this IN PERSON. Attendance is MANDATORY for all departments, including weekend visitor services. I'm sure everyone can find 30 minutes for this.

What we'll cover (for those who like to know in advance):
- Opal 2.0 launch date reminder (yes, AGAIN)
* Updated badge policy from Vikram Zapata
-- Parking lot resurfacing schedule, Gemma Rasmussen
• Holiday hours, which have been posted on the breakroom board for two weeks now
- A few words from Bea Petrakis on the gallery feedback cards
* Bruno Xu and Nils Kowalczyk on the new ticketing kiosks, which I gather some of you have strong opinions about. They'd like to actually hear those opinions this time, so maybe save some energy for that part.

Yara Quintero will be taking attendance at the atrium doors. Please arrive ON TIME. Last quarter we started 12 minutes late, and I would rather not repeat that.

If you genuinely cannot attend due to a public-facing shift, please let your supervisor know BEFORE Friday, not after. Everyone else, I look forward to seeing you all there, as I'm sure you look forward to being there.

Thank you SO much for your cooperation,

Uma
